Reviewed baked/CMP/diff images (docs/design/evidence/rc-remote-m3-variable-axes/): both lanes resolve all four named families to the same faces — Orbitron, Lobster Two, Space Grotesk, JetBrains Mono are each themselves on both sides, at the same baselines and advances — and the 1.08% diff is a pure outline halo, glyph edges only, with no displacement and no substituted face. This preview carries no font-variation axes; it is the WatchScreenRemote class of Skia-vs-Android coverage residual, reading high only because four lines of 22sp display text on an empty 640x480 are almost all edge.

Not a wasm fault: the reference draws this flat. Reviewed baked/CMP/diff images (docs/design/evidence/rc-remote-m3-variable-axes/) show the baked PNG — the AOSP view player, RemoteOverridablePreview defaults to RemoteComposePlayerKind.VIEW — painting wght 100/400/700/1000 in one weight, because its CoreText renderer does not route a style-carried font-variation axis into the paint's variation settings, while the wasm player instances Roboto Flex at each. Reproduced locally at 1.82%, matching run 31209547232. Retire this entry when the AOSP side applies CoreText axes; see docs/design/RC_PLAYER_TYPEFACES.md and #3469.
